title: Thai-Style Stir Fry
description: A quick and flavorful Thai-style stir fry made with juicy chicken, earthy vegetables, and a hint of Thai spices. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil to the skillet.
Add the onion and bell pepper to the skillet and cook until they start to soften, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the snow peas to the skillet and cook until they are tender, about 2-3 minutes.
Add the curry paste to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables and curry paste.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped basil.
